title: Where Relevance Emerges: A Layer-Wise Study of Internal Attention for Zero-Shot Re-Ranking
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical aspects of document re-ranking using internal attention signals in Large Language Models. It benchmarks performance across standard retrieval datasets such as BEIR and TREC-DL and reasoning tasks in the BRIGHT benchmark. There is no component evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, morals, or ethics.
